chronicles-of-arithmos.assessmentNote: Landing page and manifest.json: 'Educational 2D Math RPG Game for Primary Students' — solve math problems to cast spells, adaptive difficulty, multiplayer room codes; game data 145 maps / 2784 events / 6665 dialogue lines with region unlocks (Forest, Goblin Camp, Ancient Pyramid, Tundra Town, Volcano Outpost) and Demon Lord / Numeromancer defeated switches (one map file, Map113, failed to fetch once and was not needed for the verdict); no Steam/itch/reviews/media; GitHub 0 stars; rating blank; popularity 2.

translatedTitles.ja: クロニクルズ・オブ・アリトモス

zh-Hans.summary: 面向小学生的 2D 数学教育 RPG：解出数学题即可施法、防御或攻击怪物，难度自适应，还能与同学联机解题。

en.summary: An educational 2D math RPG for primary students: solving math problems casts spells, shields or attacks, with adaptive difficulty and multiplayer room codes for classmates.

ja.summary: 小学生向けの教育系2D数学RPG。計算問題を解くと魔法や攻撃が発動し、難易度が自動調整され、クラスメイトと協力プレイもできる。

chronicles-of-the-sacred-kouign-amann.assessmentNote: No README or external trace (0 stars); game data 3 maps / 53 events / 113 French dialogue lines — a small but real Episode I beta (cliff + cave + credits) with a complete French opening monologue (tyrant Custard VI, the MDRCB stealing the kouign-amann recipe, four adventurers promised knighthood); KwiɲaˈMɑ̃n is a phonetic spelling of kouign-amann; rating blank; popularity 2.

translatedTitles.ja: 聖なるクイニアマンのクロニクル

zh-Hans.summary: 法式喜剧 RPG（第 1 集 Beta）：Crèmelune 王国，暴君治下，kouign-amann（布列塔尼黄油蛋糕）原始食谱被盗，四位冒险者奉命找回圣羊皮纸。

en.summary: A French comedy RPG (Episode I beta): in the kingdom of Crèmelune, under a tyrant king, the original kouign-amann recipe has been stolen, and four young adventurers are ordered to retrieve the sacred parchment.

ja.summary: フランス風コメディRPG（エピソードIベータ版）。クレームリューヌ王国で、暴君の治世下、クイニアマン（ブルターニュのバターケーキ）の原レシピが盗まれ、4人の若き冒険者が聖なる羊皮紙の奪還を命じられる。

tsugunohi.assessmentNote: This fork is a Vietnamese-titled re-upload of ImCyan's Tsugunohi train episode (the 2012 free version: 5 days + ending, picture-driven, only 6 text dialogue lines by design); all switches/variables/debug text remain in Japanese; title-screen picture title_terop_1.png carries a Vietnamese warning ('LƯU Ý — ĐÂY LÀ GAME KINH DỊ CÂN NHẮC TRƯỚC KHI CHƠI') while scene pictures are the Japanese originals, so languages are corrected from the old meta's [vi] to [vi, ja]; popularity scores the GAME, not this fork: the original has a Steam collection (9 stories, free), TapTap 6.0/10 (only 3 ratings), GameLoop 4.2 (8864 ratings) and 150M+ related video views, so popularity 6; this fork itself has 1 star and no external discussion; rating stays blank (no serious review evidence).

zh-Hans.summary: ImCyan 的极简日式恐怖短篇（电车篇）：少女连续五天乘电车通勤，车厢里的乘客与景象一天比一天诡异；本条目为越南语标题的转贴版本，标题画面含越南语警告，场景图为日文原作素材。

en.summary: ImCyan's minimalist Japanese horror short (the train episode): a girl commutes by train for five days as the passengers and scenery grow stranger each day; this entry is a Vietnamese-titled re-upload — its title screen carries a Vietnamese warning while the scene pictures are the Japanese originals.

ja.summary: ImCyanによる極簡日式ホラー短編（電車編）。少女が5日間電車で通勤するなか、車内の乗客や風景が日を追うごとに異様になっていく。本エントリはベトナム語タイトルの転載版で、タイトル画面にはベトナム語の警告があり、シーン画像は日本語の原作素材である。

skazka.assessmentNote: No README or external trace (0 stars); game data 51 maps / 433 events / 264 dialogue lines with quest switches (Quest1/QUEST1COMPLETE/QUEST2) and a DEMO switch, so contentType demo; СКАЗКА is Russian for 'fairy tale', CKA3KA is its look-alike Latin spelling; NOT the unrelated Steam game SKAZKA (KuKo / Mustella Games, App 1815400); Map041 'Комната траха' holds only 14 identical 'Вы получили 50 говна' (you got 50 shit) events — a crude joke currency farm, no sexual content, so nsfw stays false; rating blank; popularity 2.

zh-Hans.summary: 俄语 RPG Maker 喜剧/恐怖 RPG（demo）：中学生 Рома 从家出发，穿过森林与学校、马桶世界与噩梦，走向城堡；含任务系统与多名同伴。

en.summary: A Russian RPG Maker comedy/horror RPG (demo): Roma, a schoolboy, travels from home through the forest and school, the toilet world and nightmares, toward the castle, with a quest system and several companions.

ja.summary: ロシア語のツクール製コメディ／ホラーRPG（デモ版）。中学生ローマが家を出発し、森や学校、トイレの世界や悪夢を越えて城を目指す。クエストシステムと複数の仲間がいる。
